verdict.rationale: Docs clearly support mid-conversation function calling: client-side tools, server-side webhook tools that call third-party APIs, sandboxed custom JS, and MCP server integration, explicitly described as enabling 'real-time information' and 'authenticated actions like scheduling meetings or order returns' during conversation, plus low-latency ultra-low-latency voice delivery claims which address the 'no dead air' aspect. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks or user reports confirming actual latency during tool calls (only vendor docs, no third-party corroboration of seamlessness).
